description.narrative: (Uganda): SITES is the strategic information mechanism for the Mission's health portfolio. The activity aims to strengthen Uganda's health information systems and build Uganda's capacity to collect, analyze, disseminate, and use data for decision making at national and regional levels. With FY 2022 funds, the activity will consolidate the support to the Ministry of Health (MOH) and implementing partners to increase the quality, availability, and timeliness of tuberculosis data. With Malaria, MCH, FP and Nutrition funds, SITES will consolidate the support to the MOH Division of Health Information, the National Malaria Control Program, the Reproductive Health Division, the Child Health Division, and the Community Health Department to strengthen the quality, availability, and timeliness of reproductive health; nutrition; child health; and water, sanitation, and hygiene data at the national and subnational levels. SITES will fund activities to improve gender equality and empower women to access and use high quality health services, activities that prevent gender-based violence and address the impact of gender-based violence, multisectoral activities to improve nutrition outcomes, activities to improve access and utilization of micronutrients. By strengthening resilient health systems at national and sub-national level, the activity will respond to climate related service delivery disruptions...
